decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The fetched concept doc still says public preview and managed-settings control. No lifecycle change is shown. Tenant policy, data, audit, and network evidence is not in the fetch, so every gate stays unknown. Human dates are not renewed.

citations.quote: Computer use is in public preview and subject to change.
Enterprise administrators can disable computer use through managed settings. Enabling computer use locally does not override an enterprise policy.

findings.reason: Doc states public preview on macOS and Windows. No tested client version or eligible pilot identity is evidenced.
findings.next: Record the client version and a named pilot cohort.
